scope: Publish the already collected Codex native acceptance evidence. No native invocation, target setup/import/check, or fixture reconstruction was run during publication.
byte_preservation: All retained source files are unchanged. The original local source remains unchanged. Original SHA256SUMS is retained as source-SHA256SUMS; source-inventory.json maps each original file/hash to its byte-identical published file or explicit omission. SHA256SUMS covers every published file except itself.

omissions.reason: Standalone CLI configuration omitted conservatively; its original SHA-256 is preserved, not its contents.

sensitive_data: No credentials, credential links, raw private configuration, hidden reasoning or unrelated developer instructions are included. The source archive was already sanitized under export-policy.json. Public tracked deep-review contract snapshots and generated role snapshots are historical evidence, not installed or authoritative role configuration.
preserved_observations: Native IDs, commands/results, public native messages, state, verification records, declared source identities, environment/fixture policy and hashes are retained. Config and role fingerprint hashes are evidence of unchanged state, not configuration contents. Controlled /tmp fixture paths and previously public source paths remain to preserve exact commands and provenance.
inspection: Source checksum verification; recursive event-type allowlist inspection; credential/private-key/authorization/opaque-payload pattern scan including the vendored archive; static inventory and source-byte comparison. No acceptance test was rerun.
historical_records: final-report.md, coordinator-report.md, run-state.json and publication/ describe the earlier acceptance and initial PR report publication. Their paths, statuses, dates and pending-cleanup fields are historical observations, with preservation-receipt.json recording the completed cleanup. This README and publication-policy.json describe this subsequent repository publication.
snapshot_name_reason: Immutable historical JSON and contract/validator snapshots use .txt names. This preserves exact bytes and identifies them as captured evidence rather than current prose or duplicate authoritative workflow documents. No checker or implementation change was made. The source inventory maps original names to published names.
